findings.summary: The cart product image alternative repeated the adjacent product heading.
findings.fix: Give the cart image an empty alternative and support decorative alternatives in ProductImage.
findings.evidence: A product name was announced by both the image and the heading.

passed: Cart, checkout, and confirmation have one H1 each and coherent heading levels.
The document title, skip link, main landmark, and footer landmark are present.
Cart product images are now decorative because their adjacent headings identify the products.
notes: Findings were recorded before their indicated fixes; the final implementation was verified afterward.
